title: TDscript CapabilityScope & Sandboxing Specification
description: Spatial sandboxing, capability bitmasks, and hardware address whitelisting

NET_READ.description: Permission to ping and perform HTTP GET

NET_SCAN.description: Permission to scan TCP ports and send WoL magic packets

PLC_READ.description: Permission to read Modbus holding registers

PLC_WRITE.description: Permission to write Modbus holding registers

BT_ACCESS.description: Permission to connect to BLE peripherals and exchange data

HARDWARE.description: Permission to access I2C bus, UART Serial, and hardware Watchdog

UI_CORE.description: Permission to display toasts and system logs

BACKGROUND.description: Permission to run background tasks without UI focus

capabilities.description: Bitwise OR combination of allowed capability flags

allowed_i2c_addresses.description: Hexadecimal whitelist of allowed 7-bit I2C addresses (e.g. ["0x76"])

allowed_modbus_registers.description: Allowed Modbus host and register intervals

allowed_serial_ports.description: Whitelist of allowed serial device paths (e.g. ["/dev/ttyUSB0"])

max_steps.description: Execution step budget before StepLimiter triggers automatic emergency halt
